_comments.source: Hand-curated 2026-04-05. Chronic, medication-managed metabolic condition. Like high-blood-pressure this stress-tests whether the procedure-volume pipeline architecture generalizes to non-procedural care — but diabetes is *slightly* more procedure-coded than HTN because of the diabetes-specific G-codes and nutrition-therapy codes.
_comments.hcpcs_rationale: 83036 HbA1c is the canonical monitoring lab (every 3-6 months). 82947 fasting glucose and 82043 urine microalbumin (nephropathy screen) are the other two monitoring-standard labs. 80053 CMP and 80061 lipid panel are baseline workup. 99213/99214 E&M dominate the visit volume. G0108/G0109 are diabetes self-management training codes unique to this condition. G0270/G0271 and 97802/97803 are medical nutrition therapy. 92250 fundus photography for retinopathy screening.
_comments.taxonomy_rationale: Endocrinology/Diabetes & Metabolism is the formal sub-specialty. Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, and General Practice manage the majority of cases. Nephrology gets the diabetic kidney disease patients. Ophthalmology is included for retinopathy screening, Podiatry for foot care.
_comments.pubmed_rationale: Management and monitoring queries, drug-class queries (metformin, GLP-1, insulin), and major complication queries (nephropathy, retinopathy, neuropathy, cardiovascular).
